subject: Whitestone: consolidation of DPA redlines and SCCs Q&A
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-18T08:14:00-08:00
Subject: Whitestone — DPA redlines received (SCCs + Order Form)

Team,

We received Whitestone's redlines this morning (attached). They pushed back on the controller/processor split in Clause 3, requested an expanded SCCs annex, and included several operational questions around KMS and regional hosting for a subset of EU customers. High level: they are OK with the Order Form commercial terms but want DPA exceptions documented and a transfer-impact addendum for EU hosting.

Please can we:
- Legal (Laura): pull a consolidated redline (track changes) that ties our standard DPA to their edits and flags any non-starters. Prioritize the controller/processor language and the indemnity/cross-liability phrasing.
- Privacy/Engineering (Rishi): validate the technical assertions in their SCCs Q&A (KMS key ownership, audit log retention, data residency options) and provide short, citation-backed answers we can include in the response.
- Sales (Ben): I'll defer to you for commercial posture; if we need an incremental credit or limited addendum (e.g., separate hosting surcharge) call it out.

Customer timeline: procurement asked for final legal position by EOD Tuesday (2026-12-22). They want a short joint call if we have open items — proposed window Wed 12/23 09:00–11:00 PT.

Attachments: Whitestone_DPA_Redlines_v2.docx, Whitestone_SCCs_Questions.pdf

I'll coordinate the consolidation. If legal needs a clean MSA + Order Form bundle to redline against, I can pull the docs.

Thanks,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Head of Customer Privacy Ops
Redwood Inference

Subject: RE: Whitestone — DPA redlines received (SCCs + Order Form)

Claire — thanks for the redlines and the detailed Q&A (received). Mina is coordinating legal on our side and Laura will consolidate. Quick plan from my side:

1) We will produce a consolidated redline + point-by-point Q&A for the SCCs by Tue EOD (12/22).
2) If there are open technical items after Rishi's review, propose a 30–45m call Wed 12/23 at 09:30 PT to close. Please confirm whether that works for Tom and procurement.
3) We do prefer to avoid changing our controller/processor model where not strictly necessary; if Whitestone needs specific language for certain subprocessors or hosting, let's capture that as an annex/addendum rather than changing the DPA core.

Proposed next steps for you: confirm call availability and confirm whether the redline in Whitestone_DPA_Redlines_v2.docx is the authoritative negotiation copy. If procurement prefers DocuSign for the final sign, drop the link and we'll route to legal.

Best,
Ben

Subject: Re: Whitestone — DPA redlines received (SCCs + Order Form)

Ben / Mina / Laura,

Thanks for the quick acknowledgement. A few clarifications from our side to help legal:

1) Controller/Processor: We are primarily a controller for patient records collected through our apps. We flagged the split because we need an explicit carveout for customer-supplied training data and diagnostic telemetry — if you can add an annex that maps those datasets to the processor role that would be ideal.

2) KMS & Keys: We do not want Redwood to hold root keys for EU-resident patient datasets. We're asking for the option to have keys stored in our KMS (Azure Key Vault) with Redwood able to use ephemeral wrapped keys for runtime decryption. Is that a supported model? Please include an operational flow diagram or short bullet list in your Q&A.

3) SCCs: we've annotated Annex A with comments (see Whitestone_SCCs_Questions.pdf). Two asks: (a) confirm the exact audit log retention period for access to patient records and (b) whether Redwood can provide subprocessor flowcharts for cross-border subprocessors.

We can do Wed 12/23 09:30 PT. Procurement would like final positions marked in the redline doc before the call.

Attachments: Whitestone_DPA_Redlines_v2.docx (authoritative redline), Whitestone_SCCs_Questions.pdf

Thanks,
Claire Howell
Head of Legal & Privacy
Whitestone Health

Subject: Internal: Whitestone redline — legal + technical asks (summary)

Laura / Rishi / Soojin,

Summary of customer asks (from Claire's note):
- Controller/Processor mapping: customer wants a narrow annex that classifies (i) patient records as controller-owned, (ii) customer-supplied training data and telemetry as processor-scoped. We should propose annex wording that preserves our standard DPA while granting the carveout.
- KMS model: customer requests that root keys remain in their Azure Key Vault; Redwood to accept wrapped ephemeral keys for live inference. They want an operational flow.
- Audit logs: confirm retention period and whether we can export log slices for regulated audits.
- Subprocessor list and cross-border flowcharts.

Action items:
- Laura: draft consolidated redline and propose annex language for the dataset carveout. Call out any legal risks from the carveout (liability, data subject requests, deletion obligations). Target: Tue EOD 12/22 for the consolidated redline.
- Rishi: can you please write a 2–3 bullet operational flow for the Azure KMS wrapped-key model (include whether we support external CMKs, what keys we hold, and whether any key material is exported). Also confirm audit log retention and export options. Target: Mon 12/21 COB.
- Soojin: please pull the current subprocessor map and a simple cross-border flow chart we can attach. Target: Mon 12/21 COB.
- Ben: hold the Wed 12/23 09:30 PT slot; confirm with procurement if they prefer DocuSign or signed PDF.

I'll consolidate outputs and send the customer a combined package ahead of the call. If legal needs additional context from product, let me know — I can join the call.

Mina
